label: Coolant Overheating Trend
desc: Engine coolant temperature sustained above calibrated threshold (>105°C) — cooling circuit loss or thermostat stuck
recommendedPart: OEM Water Pump & Thermostat Assembly Kit

label: 12V Auxiliary Voltage Sag
desc: System bus voltage drops below nominal 12.4V — alternator diode ripple breakdown or parasitic battery draw
recommendedPart: Valeo 140A Alternator Diode Pack & Auxiliary Battery

label: Combustion Misfire Cylinder 3
desc: Combustion irregularity detected in Cylinder 3 — direct ignition coil discharge interruption or injector nozzle fouling
recommendedPart: Denso Direct Ignition Coil & NGK Iridium Plugs (Set of 4)

label: Combustion Misfire Cylinder 1
desc: Cylinder 1 misfire pattern observed under torque load — high-pressure fuel rail pulse anomaly

label: High-Voltage EV Pack Degradation
desc: High-voltage traction battery cell voltage variance > 120mV — State of Health below warranty baseline
recommendedPart: BMS High-Voltage Cell Balancing Harness Kit

label: Fuel Trim System Too Lean (Bank 1)
desc: Bank 1 air-to-fuel ratio too lean — unmetered post-MAF intake air leak or fuel pump pressure drift
recommendedPart: Bosch MAF Sensor & Intake Manifold O-Rings

label: Catalytic Converter Below BS-VI Threshold
desc: Three-way catalytic converter oxygen storage efficiency below BS-VI stage 2 compliance threshold

label: Idle Air Control RPM Sustained High
desc: Idle air rotational rate sustained > 250 RPM above calibrated ECU target — throttle butterfly carbon accumulation
recommendedPart: Electronic Throttle Body Decarb Service Kit
